text:
Which statement about evaporation is correct?
A
A body in contact with an evaporating liquid loses thermal energy.
B
A decrease in the surface area of an evaporating liquid increases the rate of evaporation.
C
A wind over a liquid decreases the rate of evaporation.
D
It is necessary to provide an external source of thermal energy to a liquid for it to evaporate.

options.label: A
options.text: A body in contact with an evaporating liquid loses thermal energy.

options.label: B
options.text: A decrease in the surface area of an evaporating liquid increases the rate of evaporation.

options.label: C
options.text: A wind over a liquid decreases the rate of evaporation.

options.label: D
options.text: It is necessary to provide an external source of thermal energy to a liquid for it to evaporate.
